text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with their partner Umamusume, the 
challenge for the Twinkle Series was 
finally about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer, too, must run alongside them 
with everything they have, supporting 
those chasing their dreams as a true 
three-legged race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, a support AI called the "Mega 
Dream Supporter" was introduced as a 
powerful ally for Trainers and Umamusume 
alike.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate AI that aggregates and 
analyzes data from throughout the history 
of Umamusume racing to provide the optimal 
support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of their partner Umamusume, 
the Trainers stepped into the VR world, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Waiting there were Umamusume bearing the 
names of the Three Goddesses, formed and 
brought to life by three AIs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With those who oversee the vast amounts of 
data on their side, the curtain rises on 
the Twinkle Series.
